summary: Iteration-5: verified WhatsApp / mitra-blast / unsold-in-PDF feature set. Backend: 37/37 pytest passing (added 5 new tests covering whatsapp_number CRUD, migration back-fill, dashboard unsold products enumeration + stok field, empty-products mitra). Frontend: verified end-to-end blast flow + individual WA send with popup URL inspection and PDF download.

issues: Recharts logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial render — cosmetic.
SheetContent missing SheetTitle/Description — Radix a11y console error.

critical_code_review_comments: POST/PUT /api/mitra correctly `.strip()` whatsapp_number and defaults to '' when Optional. Migration on startup back-fills whatsapp_number='' for existing docs (verified via test_all_existing_mitras_have_whatsapp_field). ✓

GET /api/dashboard/today rebuilt to enumerate products per mitra (products_by_mitra dict), so items array now includes unsold products with jumlah_terjual=0 and 'stok' field. Aggregates recomputed from product-level rows — verified numerically (Bu Ade: 6 Burgers sold → sales 54000, profit 6000; Hotdog+Sandwich contribute 0). ✓

Dashboard MitraCard uses items.filter(qty>0) for on-screen listing (Burger visible; Hotdog/Sandwich hidden) while PDF via buildMitraPDF renders all items (verified filename downloaded: rekap-Bu_Ade_Juleha-2026-07-06.pdf). ✓

sendReportToMitra: calls exportMitraPDF({silent:true}) then window.open(waLink). Observed 2 window.open calls: (1) blob URL for PDF, (2) https://wa.me/6281234567890?text=Halo%20kak%20Bu%20Ade%20Juleha%2C%20berikut%20rincian%20hasil%20penjualan%20hari%20ini%20ya! — exact format required. ✓

normalizeWaNumber('081234567890') → '6281234567890' verified. waLink builds https://wa.me/{p}?text={encodeURIComponent(msg)} correctly (comma encoded as %2C, space as %20, ! kept as literal — RFC-3986 allows). ✓

Blast modal correctly splits readyMitras (has WA + items.length>0) from notReadyMitras. In test env only Bu Ade Juleha qualifies (1 ready row; 'Belum ada nomor WhatsApp' section absent because all 10 other mitras have items.length===0 and are excluded from both sections). Verify E1 intended this or not — mitras with no products AND no WA are silently omitted from both lists.

PDF halign='left' applied consistently to headStyles/bodyStyles/footStyles/columnStyles in both exportDashboardPDF and buildMitraPDF. Per-mitra PDF columns: [Produk, Harga Produk, Jumlah Terjual, Total] — 'Harga Jual' correctly NOT included per requirement. ✓

Product 'Hotdog' has stok=0 and jumlah_terjual=0 in Bu Ade Juleha's card — daily reset via lazy _reset_products_if_stale() may have set jumlah=0. This is expected (products auto-reset each business day at 23:59 WIB).
(carry-over) CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid — set explicit origins for prod.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — blast modal opens with 1 ready row + Kirim button; click triggers PDF download (rekap-Bu_Ade_Juleha-2026-07-06.pdf) + wa.me popup with correct phone (6281234567890) and message; card hides unsold items; Mitra page WA column + form input verified.
